description: This data set is a 2017 extract of the Kenya Master Health Facility List, the Ministry of Health's register of every health facility and community unit in Kenya. It was taken from the ministry's KMHFL portal, developed with USAID and other partners, and published on the Humanitarian Data Exchange by the UN humanitarian office for southern and eastern Africa. Each of about 8,900 facilities has a unique code, name, registration number, level in the Kenya Essential Package for Health (KEPH), type, owner, regulatory body, numbers of beds and cots, county, constituency, sub-county and ward, operational status, whether it opens around the clock, at weekends and on public holidays, and the services it offers. Coverage is national. The extract is free and available to download as Excel under CC BY. Caveats: it dates from August 2017, has no coordinates (locations are given by ward), and the live registry did not answer from this environment, so current data should be taken from the ministry's portal where reachable. Simulation uses: estimating bed capacity by county for surge and disaster planning, mapping facility levels against flood and drought exposure, and modelling referral networks by KEPH level. Related records: the Kenya ICU beds by hospital (data-kenya-icu-beds-by-hospital-2020) and the sub-Saharan Africa public health facilities database (data-ssa-public-health-facilities), which has coordinates.
